top_tourist_places.name: Laxman Jhula & Ram Jhula
top_tourist_places.description: Iconic suspension bridges over the Ganges, connecting major temples and ashrams.

top_tourist_places.name: Triveni Ghat
top_tourist_places.description: The most sacred bathing ghat in Rishikesh, famous for the evening Ganga Aarti.

top_tourist_places.name: Parmarth Niketan
top_tourist_places.description: One of the largest ashrams in Rishikesh, known for its spiritual atmosphere and yoga classes.

top_tourist_places.name: The Beatles Ashram (Chaurasi Kutia)
top_tourist_places.description: The ruins of the ashram where The Beatles stayed in 1968, now a serene forest reserve with graffiti art.

top_tourist_places.name: Shivpuri
top_tourist_places.description: The hub of adventure in Rishikesh, located 19km from the town.

top_tourist_places.name: Neer Garh Waterfall
top_tourist_places.description: A series of three beautiful waterfalls accessible via a short hike.

top_tourist_places.name: Neelkanth Mahadev Temple
top_tourist_places.description: Ancient temple dedicated to Lord Shiva, situated at 1330m height with panoramic valley views.

underrated_hidden_gems.name: Patna Waterfall
underrated_hidden_gems.description: A secluded waterfall reached through a dense forest trek, offering peace and untouched nature.

underrated_hidden_gems.name: Vashishta Gufa (Cave)
underrated_hidden_gems.description: An ancient cave on the banks of the Ganges where sage Vashishta meditated for years.

underrated_hidden_gems.name: Garud Chatti Waterfall
underrated_hidden_gems.description: A hidden gem near the Neelkanth temple road, perfect for those seeking solitude.

underrated_hidden_gems.name: Phool Chatti Ashram Area
underrated_hidden_gems.description: A quiet stretch of riverbanks and trails away from the main city's bustle.

underrated_hidden_gems.name: Rishikund
underrated_hidden_gems.description: A sacred ancient pond near Raghunath Temple, known for its reflection of the Shani temple.

underrated_hidden_gems.name: Jhilmil Gufa
underrated_hidden_gems.description: A group of three caves in the forest near Neelkanth temple, used for deep meditation.

underrated_hidden_gems.name: Goa Beach
underrated_hidden_gems.description: A quiet white-sand beach on the Ganges near Laxman Jhula, popular among backpackers.
